name: House of Wonders
scope: Complete House of Wonders in its intact October2010 museum phase: whole roughly50m quadrilateral palace, all four deep external verandas on three high storeys, iron columns/brackets/open gallery railings, original high timber entry and approach steps, complete main metal roof, central raised rooflight and projecting clocktower including roof. Intrinsic covered atrium and galleries retain their architectural void; no neighboring palace/fort/gardens/cannons/trees/vehicles/exhibits. Full mapped whole outline and all three intrinsic roof/tower parts retained. Precise rear bay census, clocktower vertical bands, roof junctions and historic grade are bounded architectural estimates from complete native parts, clear partial front/interior/detail originals and primary dimensional text; not a measured restoration survey. No claim of current post2020 survival.
